mapper.insert: INSERT INTO library_file (member_id, name, file_size, content) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{name}, #{fileSize}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.member_id, m.name AS uploader, f.name, f.file_size, f.created_at FROM library_file f JOIN member m ON m.id = f.member_id ORDER BY f.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO library_reply (file_id, member_id, content) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{memberId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.file_id, r.member_id, m.name AS writer, r.content, r.created_at FROM library_reply r JOIN member m ON m.id = r.member_id ORDER BY r.id
